notes.title: Full Episode 1 ready NOW!
notes.notes:
Are you ready for 5 more levels - 5 brand new levels - taking us to the complete Episode 1 of Beyond Flesh and Blood in Early Access? 

Since the team here at Pixelbomb Games put BFB out there in Early Access we've smashed it onto over 7,000 of your wishlists (about to hit 8,000 as this is being typed); there's nearly 3,000 of you in this group alone. THANKYOU SO, SO MUCH from the whole development team as we take you on this journey with us, from kick-ass PC game all the way through to porting out the full game - all 26 levels - onto console.

You've got 12 levels now and another 14 on the way. 

Get gory.
Go Beyond Flesh and Blood. ːsteamhappyː
In the Steam store now: http://store.steampowered.com/app/391550
